points.title: 童年与少年
points.description: 萨特于1905年6月21日出生于巴黎，父亲是海军军官，在他不到两岁时去世。母亲带着他回到娘家，由外祖父阿尔贝·施韦泽（哲学家阿尔贝·施韦泽的堂兄）抚养。萨特从小展现出非凡的智力，四岁开始阅读，七岁开始写作。这段时期他接受了良好的教育，但也经历了多次搬家和寄宿学校的生活，形成了独立思考和反叛的性格。1915年，萨特进入亨利四中学，开始接触哲学，并结识了后来成为重要思想家的保罗·尼赞。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Paris on June 21, 1905, Sartre lost his naval officer father before he was two. His mother moved back to her parents' home, where Sartre was raised by his maternal grandfather, Albert Schweitzer (cousin of the philosopher). Sartre showed exceptional intelligence from an early age, reading at four and writing at seven. He received a good education but experienced multiple moves and boarding schools, developing an independent and rebellious character. In 1915, Sartre entered the Henri IV School, where he began studying philosophy and met Paul Nizan, who would become an important thinker.

points.title: 哲学深造
points.description: 1924年，萨特考入巴黎高等师范学院，这是法国最负盛名的精英学府之一。在这里，他系统学习了哲学、心理学和文学，深受胡塞尔现象学和海德格尔存在主义思想的影响。他与西蒙娜·德·波伏娃、莫里斯·梅洛-庞蒂等建立了深厚的友谊和思想联系。1929年，萨特通过了哲学教师资格考试，获得第二名，波伏瓦获得第一名。这一时期，萨特开始形成自己的存在主义哲学思想，并创作了早期文学作品，如《恶心》的雏形。
points.descriptionEn: In 1924, Sartre entered the École Normale Supérieure, France's most prestigious elite institution. Here, he systematically studied philosophy, psychology, and literature, deeply influenced by Husserl's phenomenology and Heidegger's existentialist thought. He formed deep friendships and intellectual connections with Simone de Beauvoir, Maurice Merleau-Ponty, and others. In 1929, Sartre passed the philosophy agrégation exam, coming in second, while Beauvoir came first. During this period, Sartre began developing his own existentialist philosophy and wrote early literary works, including the precursor to 'Nausea'.

points.title: 现象学研究
points.description: 1933-1935年，萨特获得法国政府奖学金前往柏林法兰西学院研究现象学。在柏林，他深入研读了胡塞尔的著作，特别是《观念》和《形式的与先验的逻辑》，并开始接触海德格尔的《存在与时间》。这段经历对他哲学思想的成熟至关重要，使他能够将德国现象学与法国哲学传统相结合。萨特在柏林期间完成了《自我的超越性》的写作，这是他早期重要的哲学著作，奠定了他后来存在主义思想的基础。同时，他开始构思小说《恶心》，这部作品后来成为他文学创作的代表作。
points.descriptionEn: From 1933 to 1935, Sartre received a French government scholarship to study phenomenology at the French Institute in Berlin. In Berlin, he deeply studied Husserl's works, particularly 'Ideas' and 'Formal and Transcendental Logic,' and began reading Heidegger's 'Being and Time.' This experience was crucial for the maturation of his philosophical thought, enabling him to combine German phenomenology with French philosophical traditions. During his Berlin period, Sartre wrote 'The Transcendence of the Ego,' an important early philosophical work that laid the foundation for his later existentialist thought. He also began conceiving his novel 'Nausea,' which would become a masterpiece of his literary work.

points.title: 战争经历
points.description: 1939年二战爆发后，萨特被征召入伍，担任气象员。1940年6月，他在法国东部被德军俘虏，被关押在纳粹战俘营中。在战俘营的九个月里，萨特继续思考和写作，与战俘们组织哲学讨论。这段经历让他深刻体会到人的自由处境和责任，强化了他的存在主义思想。1941年3月，萨特因健康原因获释回到巴黎。战俘营的经历成为他思想发展的重要转折点，使他更加关注人的自由、选择和责任，这些主题后来成为他战后哲学和文学创作的核心。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of WWII in 1939, Sartre was drafted and served as a meteorologist. In June 1940, he was captured by German forces in eastern France and imprisoned in a Nazi POW camp. During his nine months in captivity, Sartre continued to think and write, organizing philosophical discussions with fellow prisoners. This experience deepened his understanding of human freedom and responsibility, reinforcing his existentialist thought. In March 1941, Sartre was released due to health reasons and returned to Paris. The POW camp experience became a crucial turning point in his intellectual development, leading him to focus more on themes of human freedom, choice, and responsibility, which later became central to his post-war philosophical and literary work.

points.title: 存在主义高峰
points.description: 二战后，萨特成为法国知识界的领袖人物。1945年，他创办了《现代》杂志，成为左翼知识分子的重要阵地。1946年，他发表《存在主义是一种人道主义》，系统阐述了他的存在主义哲学思想，使存在主义成为战后欧洲最具影响力的哲学流派之一。这一时期，萨特创作了大量重要作品，包括戏剧《禁闭》、《死无葬身之地》和《魔鬼与上帝》，以及哲学著作《辩证理性批判》。萨特积极参与政治活动，支持阿尔及利亚独立运动，反对法国殖民主义，并拒绝接受1964年的诺贝尔文学奖，理由是他'不愿被制度化'。这一时期，萨特的思想和作品对全球知识分子产生了深远影响，使他成为20世纪最具标志性的哲学家之一。
points.descriptionEn: After WWII, Sartre became a leading figure in French intellectual life. In 1945, he founded the journal 'Les Temps Modernes,' which became a major platform for left-wing intellectuals. In 1946, he published 'Existentialism is a Humanism,' systematically articulating his existentialist philosophy and making existentialism one of the most influential philosophical movements in post-war Europe. During this period, Sartre produced numerous important works, including plays 'No Exit,' 'The Flies,' and 'The Devil and the Good Lord,' as well as the philosophical work 'Critique of Dialectical Reason.' Sartre actively participated in political activities, supporting the Algerian independence movement and opposing French colonialism. He refused the 1964 Nobel Prize in Literature, stating he did not want to be 'institutionalized.' During this period, Sartre's thought and work had a profound impact on intellectuals worldwide, making him one of the most iconic philosophers of the 20th century.

points.title: 晚年与政治参与
points.description: 1968年五月风暴后，萨特更加积极地参与政治活动，支持学生运动和左翼政治。他访问古巴、中国和苏联，与菲德尔·卡斯特罗、毛泽东等领导人会面，并发表支持这些国家的言论。1970年代，萨特转向马克思主义，试图将存在主义与马克思主义相结合，提出'存在主义的马克思主义'理论。他继续写作和发表政治评论，支持各种左翼事业。1971年，萨特失明，但仍然坚持口述创作。1980年4月15日，萨特在巴黎逝世，享年74岁，葬礼吸引了数万人参加，成为法国历史上规模最大的知识分子葬礼之一。萨特的晚年思想更加关注政治和社会问题，他的存在主义哲学与政治行动的结合，对后来的知识分子和政治运动产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After the May 1968 uprisings, Sartre became even more actively involved in politics, supporting student movements and left-wing causes. He visited Cuba, China, and the Soviet Union, meeting with leaders like Fidel Castro and Mao Zedong, and expressing support for these countries. In the 1970s, Sartre turned to Marxism, attempting to synthesize existentialism with Marxism and proposing the theory of 'existentialist Marxism.' He continued to write and publish political commentary, supporting various left-wing causes. In 1971, Sartre became blind but continued to work through dictation. On April 15, 1980, Sartre died in Paris at the age of 74. His funeral attracted tens of thousands of attendees, becoming one of the largest funerals for an intellectual in French history. In his later years, Sartre's thought focused more on political and social issues, and his combination of existentialist philosophy with political action had a profound impact on later intellectuals and political movements.

supporter.zh: 萨特是20世纪最具影响力的哲学家之一，他的存在主义哲学强调人的自由、选择和责任，为现代人提供了面对荒诞世界的精神支柱。作为知识分子，他积极参与政治，反对殖民主义和压迫，体现了知识分子的社会责任感。萨特与波伏娃的关系模式挑战了传统婚姻观念，为女性主义思想提供了重要参考。他的文学创作深刻探索了人类处境，《恶心》和《禁闭》等作品成为现代主义文学的经典。萨特拒绝诺贝尔奖的举动，彰显了他对独立思想的坚持和对知识自由的捍卫。
supporter.en: Sartre was one of the most influential philosophers of the 20th century, whose existentialist philosophy emphasizing human freedom, choice, and responsibility provided a spiritual foundation for modern people facing an absurd world. As an intellectual, he actively participated in politics, opposing colonialism and oppression, embodying the social responsibility of intellectuals. Sartre's relationship with Beauvoir challenged traditional marriage concepts, providing important reference for feminist thought. His literary works deeply explored the human condition, with works like 'Nausea' and 'No Exit' becoming classics of modernist literature. Sartre's refusal of the Nobel Prize demonstrated his commitment to independent thought and defense of intellectual freedom.

critic.zh: 萨特的思想受到多方面批评。首先，他的存在主义被指责为过于抽象，忽视了社会结构和历史条件对人的决定性影响。其次，他后期转向马克思主义被批评为机会主义和理论上的不一致。萨特对苏联和中国的支持也受到质疑，这些国家的人权记录与他的自由理念相矛盾。此外，萨特对暴力的辩护和对某些极权政权的同情，使他受到'左翼天真'的批评。他的个人生活也受到争议，包括与多名女性的复杂关系，以及有时被指责为自我中心的言行。这些批评反映了萨特思想中的矛盾和局限性，也揭示了知识分子在政治参与中的困境。
critic.en: Sartre's thought has faced criticism on multiple fronts. First, his existentialism was accused of being too abstract, neglecting the decisive impact of social structures and historical conditions on individuals. Second, his later turn to Marxism was criticized as opportunistic and theoretically inconsistent. Sartre's support for the Soviet Union and China was also questioned, as these countries' human rights records contradicted his ideals of freedom. Additionally, Sartre's defense of violence and sympathy for certain totalitarian regimes led to accusations of 'left-wing naivete.' His personal life was also controversial, including complex relationships with multiple women and sometimes being accused of self-centered behavior. These criticisms reflect the contradictions and limitations in Sartre's thought, and also reveal the dilemmas intellectuals face in political engagement.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，萨特被定义为20世纪最具标志性的知识分子形象之一。他代表了战后欧洲知识分子的政治参与模式，将哲学思考与社会行动紧密结合。萨特的存在主义思想超越了学术圈，成为大众文化的一部分，影响了一代人的生活方式和价值观。他的名言'他人即地狱'成为流行文化中的标志性表达。萨特与波伏娃的关系模式也成为现代伴侣关系的参考范式。尽管他的某些政治立场受到质疑，但萨特对知识自由的坚持和对权威的批判精神，使他成为知识分子独立性的象征。在当代，萨特的思想仍然被广泛讨论和引用，他的作品继续影响着哲学、文学和政治理论领域。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Sartre is defined as one of the most iconic intellectual figures of the 20th century. He represented the model of political engagement for post-war European intellectuals, closely integrating philosophical thought with social action. Sartre's existentialist philosophy transcended academic circles, becoming part of popular culture and influencing a generation's lifestyle and values. His famous quote 'Hell is other people' has become an iconic expression in popular culture. Sartre's relationship model with Beauvoir also serves as a reference paradigm for modern partnerships. Although some of his political positions have been questioned, Sartre's commitment to intellectual freedom and critical spirit toward authority made him a symbol of intellectual independence. In contemporary times, Sartre's thought continues to be widely discussed and cited, and his works continue to influence fields such as philosophy, literature, and political theory.

self.en: Man is condemned to be free.

others.zh: 萨特是我们这个时代最伟大的道德哲学家，他重新定义了知识分子的角色和责任。
others.en: Sartre was the greatest moral philosopher of our time, who redefined the role and responsibility of the intellectual.
